, by using a triple control loop organization, the grid tied inverter control can be designed to achieve a large bandwidth and robustness against common grid perturbations, without the need of resorting to more complex controllers or to the use of additional hardware.

the proposed controller can be used in a wide range of applications, from the control of small scale distributed energy resources to the design of utility interface converters for large scale microgrids.
